## Intro

[0:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=1s) Here's why I'm selling my dream 2015 custom-built Mercedes G-Wagon. It's not this one. This is the 2018 that I've also featured on this channel. But you might have seen Joe with Alliance Auto Care, nothing but G's, post a video with my G that he built. It was a process to find that vehicle. In this video, I'll be sharing the story, what the ownership was like owning that vehicle, as well as this 2018 that I'm driving right now, this limited edition, and why I'm selling it.

## Background

[0:31](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=31s) Now, if you pop over to nothing but G's, you'll see Joe has, he's consigning the vehicle for me, taking care of it. He got everything dialed up, detailed, all services up to date and ready to rock. And I've done a video on it. So I don't have it in my hands right now. Joe's shop is about 45 minutes from me. And I just wanted to make this video to share the backstory. So let's talk about that G-Wagon. How did I find it? It is a rare gem, a 2015 one, excuse me, two owner, myself for the second. Carfax will show three because the previous owner leased it and then purchased it.

[1:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=64s) So it'll show two separate owners because of the lease and purchase. But it was the same person. And it was dealer serviced and garage kept 2018. It's got just over 50,000 miles on a vehicle. Super low miles. The thing was just mint, mint, mint, mint, and super well cared for. And during the ownership of that, I built my dream truck. I remember I pulled into Joe's shop a few years ago, actually, when we picked up. Actually, let's see. I'm going to see if I can pull somewhere where there isn't anybody. And I'm going to get out because I want to show you this one.

[1:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=96s) So I pulled in. Yeah, I think we're going to go right over here. So I pulled into Joe's. No, that's not going to work. We'll get out in a few minutes. I pulled into Joe's shop. I saw a four-inch lifted G-Wagon on 35s, and I just, I lost it. I lusted over, like, the proportions, chef's kiss. Capability, chef's kiss. V8 sound, chef's kiss. Hand-built G-Wagon, chef's kiss. So I ended up really wanting one. But when we got this 2018, which I'm in now, which is, by the way, my wife's daily and our weekend vehicle together, we decided that for our use and for her getting in and out of it and all that jazz, the four-inch just wasn't right.

[2:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=142s) So I was like, no, we're going to do this two-inch lift. It's going to be awesome. And what I ended up doing is taking this one wheeling. We went to a beautiful spot in Colorado. By the way, wheeling a G-Wagon? Talk about a head turner. Like, even right now, I got folks right up here that just love it. This isn't even that wild of a build, but it's still a head turner. So anyway, I'm wheeling this one.

## The Build

[2:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=167s) And I ended up, like, setting the sidestep on a rock. And my wife, she goes, you're getting your own G. And I was like, really? I'm like, for real, though? She's like, yeah, I don't want you driving this one anymore. It was great. So I was like, all right. So the search began. And that's how I ended up with my wife, who's just, like, the most amazing wife in the whole world. It was like, do whatever you want. Have fun with it. And she loves G-Wagons. She's like, I'm keeping this vehicle for as long as I possibly can, the one that we're in.

[3:18](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=198s) So anyway, that's how it came to be. And I curated everything on that build. I went through two front bumpers, by the way. The AFN front bumper, which doesn't have integrated parking sensors. And I wanted a front bumper with a winch. I ended up with a jack wagon bumper. Big shout out to Jack at Jack Wagon. His front bumper is awesome. Best springs, in my opinion, on the market for lifts. Plus, the dude's just a legend for the G-Wagon community. And on a personal side, I love Jack. I've done videos with him as well. So my truck was like, there was no expenses spared.

[3:50](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=230s) It was like front bumper, not working, want sensors, want something beefier. The AFN looked great, but it just didn't perform the way I wanted it to when I was off-road. So I went with the Jack Wagon. Sliders. You know, those ORC, I know Joe, who's consigning it, who also makes sliders. And so does Jack, all of which are great. And I went with the ORCs because I wanted something just tighter to the vehicle. Then, you know, down to the rear, or to the wheels. I went through two sets of wheels.

[4:21](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=261s) I got wheels, and I was like, you know what? I really want beadlocks. So I've got some Alpha-equipped wheels, which is the new owner of my vehicle. And I want nothing more than to have an owner who loves that vehicle as much as I did and creates just incredible adventures with it the way it did for me. Trips to Moab, doing Imogene Pass in Colorado, you know, countless weekend adventures.

## Ownership

[4:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=286s) Like, the amount of heads it turns. I had someone, by the way, I was camping on, was it Memorial Day, I think? And I drove up this off-road trail, and there were people camped up top. And, dude, it made me laugh because they were like, I thought a helicopter was coming because of the MBRP exhaust on it. So, anywho, even the rear bumper, not only did I do the AFN, but from wheeling it, I had Joe create, like, extra strength support, so to speak, for the bumper mount to, like, custom fab to make it ultra, ultra stable.

[5:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=320s) We did these track bars because I had issues with track bars, which you saw in a video, by the way. I had a track bar crack, literally doing, like, three miles an hour. The adjustable ones, nuts kept loosening, so we ended up doing custom track bars. Like, I am talking just the most incredible care and attention for that vehicle. So, anyway, that was the back story. And ownership, so I've had that thing about a year and a half. If, from a service standpoint, after an oil change, it had a strange oil leak.

[5:50](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=350s) So, I brought it to Joe, and I was like, I got this oil leak, and I'm like, hey, listen, the vehicle's 11 years old, you know, it happens, we'll get it fixed. It turned out to be the oil filter itself just had a bad gasket. So, like, a little bit of oil was dripping. So, put a new oil filter on it and did an oil change, and that was it. And then in this 2018, which, this thing, hold on, let me see the miles on this one. This one's at 63,862, and we bought it, gosh, I can't remember if it was in the 40s or 50,000 mile range.

[6:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=382s) But on this one, which I did a bill or an update on ownership, has required, outside of normal maintenance, pretty much, I shouldn't say pretty much nothing. It has required nothing. I had oil coolant level go down. Yeah, actually, the oil coolant. I don't know why I just said oil coolant. I had a low sleep yesterday. Coolant level was a little low, and we ended up having Joe pressure test it and do all that jazz. Turned out to be fine, topped it off, and all well in the world. So, my point, these vehicles are, just have been a joy to drive.

## Why Im Selling

[6:54](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=414s) So, that leaves me, that's the ownership history. Teaser alert, easy, like, truly, truly easy. Why am I selling it after I did all that stuff to my 2018? You know, by the way, even, like, brand new EDC brakes, so it has extra stopping power for the wheels. I went through two sets of tires. I got Falcon Wild Peak ATs. I thought they were absolute garbage in the snow, and I ended up on an MT instead, which, by the way, a tire is really, really good and super, super quiet on the road, surprisingly. Actually, I think it's more quiet than my KO3s that I have on my van, on my camper van, or Sprinter van.

[7:32](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=452s) So, anyway, so why would I be selling, like, a dream vehicle? Listen, life changes, and lifestyle changes. And I've done, I did a video, I don't know, eight months ago or something. I said I was searching for a truck. My lifestyle and work and travel warranted me being in a bigger, more spacious vehicle with one thing a G-Wagon can't ever have. You know what that is? A pickup truck bed. And there's no way around it. Gosh, by the way, at Joe's, I did see that there was someone that had a pickup truck G.

[8:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=485s) Holy smokes, what I would do if they had those in the U.S. Amazing. But, anyway, it doesn't exist.

## New Vehicle

[8:11](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=491s) And what I really, really needed from a lifestyle standpoint with where I'm at is a pickup truck. Now, with two G-Wagons, an Audi S4, and a van, I said, hey, listen, it is time for me to make a change. It's time for me to get into a vehicle that's more conducive while I just simplify what I have. So, I just yesterday got rid of the Audi S4. It's actually the first vehicle I ever leased. I turned it in two months early. And what did I replace it with? I replaced it with a Ford F-150 Raptor 2026, which is awesome.

[8:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=527s) And I'll tell you this, it is a monster. I went out to dinner with my wife in it last night and parking it. It's not like parking a G that you can fit anywhere. It's not going to be used to the same way I used my old G. I'll use it for basic off-road, meaning, like, getting back into more remote areas for hiking, biking, running, and exploring in Colorado, in Utah, which is just kind of near where I hang out the most and where I live. It won't be a rock crawler. I'm leaving it stock. I'm not building it up.

And I really appreciate those, by the way, that said, hey, you know, someone, like, called me a poser, saying you're a poser because you sold the G-Wagon, which is kind of funny to me. I had two G-Wagons, which is more than most people. Got rid of one, and now, for some reason, I'm not a G-Wagon fan. But I'll tell you, these vehicles are absolutely amazing at what they do. And I cross-shopped, by the way, when I first got a G. I cross-shopped the Jeep Wrangler. Meh. Nah. Build quality, like, we don't even need to go there. The little minivan engine don't need to go there. Again, of course, you're going to build it up more capable than a G-Wagon, but if you want something really special to drive every day, there's nothing that drives like a G.

Which, by the way, I know you're like, but you just got a F-150 Raptor. I know, but I was comparing it for the use case at that time. Looked at a Raptor. Looked at Land Rover Defender. And all of it was just a no-go for me. Like, it just didn't feel special like a G-Wagon. Like, the way that these things are built and the way that they drive, there's truly nothing like it.

[10:25](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PzJL3aBRas8&t=625s) From the door clunk, all the tactile experiences are just magical. So, this is my way of saying, I absolutely love Gs. And to all my G friends, you can count on me to keep loving Gs, because this one's not going anywhere. But for my life, the truck was the right move. And in terms of just simplifying my life, which is things I'm doing, getting rid of the things that I have to think about and take care of. And, hey, I may end up, like, if I had the extra space and desire, I wouldn't have gotten rid of it. But right now, that's just not the case. So, to the new person who will someday own the G-Wheeler from this channel, just know that it has been meticulously cared for.

The interior is just in tip-top shape. Service is done. Fluids, literally, like, fluids done. Extra set of wheels. And you'll get to probably be driving the vehicle that's been featured on the channel. And know that, like, my heart goes out to you for it to create the same adventures for you that it has for me. So, thanks for tuning in to the video today. And, yeah, you'll be seeing some things.
